mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_message ( recipient_user_id, message_type, source_key, title, content, priority, target_path, read_status, create_time, update_time, is_deleted ) VALUES ( #{recipientUserId}, #{messageType}, #{sourceKey}, #{title}, #{content}, #{priority}, #{targetPath}, 0, NOW(), NOW(), 0 ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE title = VALUES(title), content = VALUES(content), priority = VALUES(priority), target_path = VALUES(target_path), update_time = NOW()
mapper.update: UPDATE t_message SET read_status = 1, read_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND recipient_user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0
